description: Points a domain at the website InkySites hosts for it: A and AAAA records to the InkySites load balancer, and a www CNAME to the domain. Email records are never touched.
variableDescription: ip4: the InkySites load balancer IPv4 address. ip6: its IPv6 address. Group 'site' is the A and AAAA pair; group 'www' is the www CNAME, applied only at the root of a domain.
